ideas.idea: Give /blog its own metadata (title/description) instead of inheriting the layout defaults
ideas.why: app/blog/page.tsx has no metadata export, so it shows the home page's title and description.

ideas.idea: Add an absolute canonical to /blog (the /docs canonical is a known problem)
ideas.why: The blog page has no canonical or metadata export, and adding one is a concrete fix.

ideas.idea: Remove the noindex from /pricing, or drop it from the sitemap and nav so the signals agree
ideas.why: This restates the known /pricing noindex problem.

ideas.idea: The /pricing canonical points to a noindex page and resolves once noindex is removed
ideas.why: This is a consequence of the known pricing noindex problem and gives no separate action.

ideas.idea: List actual plans and prices in text on /pricing to back up the description
ideas.why: The page says only 'Free for up to three people', and the description promises plans for every team size.

ideas.idea: Expand /docs beyond a single sentence with written setup steps
ideas.why: The docs page has one sentence, which doesn't cover its stated purpose of explaining how to set up Ledger.

ideas.idea: Give each blog post its own page and link to it
ideas.why: Posts are bare titles with no URLs, so they can't be found or cited individually.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to sitemap entries if real dates exist
ideas.why: It applies to almost any sitemap and has little effect, and the report itself hedges with 'might help'.
